title: 'A head-spinning day of crisis meetings all over Europe' as Trump reiterates push for Greenland
summary: The EU said on Monday it wanted to engage with the United States after President Donald Trump threatened tariffs on European countries in the standoff over Greenland, but was ready to act if needed. FRANCE 24's Brussels correspondent Dave Keating says that 'there are signs of split between European leaders as the reality sets in'.
